name: cherdenko
about: Premier Cherdenko escapes to space: he addresses his comrades, shouts SPAAAACE!, and the whole scene blasts off on a rocket flame

licence.assets: CC BY-SA 4.0. kiosk/art/cherdenko-talk.png (twelve frames of him speaking) and cherdenko-space.png (the shout) are Nula's pixel art, reduced here (cut to one box, stray edge pixels taken off, 64 colours). Premier Cherdenko is Red Alert 3's (2008) character, played by Tim Curry: an unofficial fan tribute, for our own kiosks
licence.notes: MIT, running in the OCL v1.1 + SWAtt v1 engine
